reuse.why: Introduces one guard that all five provider link functions call, using the existing db.first helper; there was no prior check to reuse.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link rule is written once; each provider adds only a call with its own source name and id.

placement.why: The guard runs at the top of each link handler before any bank, account or payee is created; it sits in accounts/app.ts, although the tree's shared link helpers (findOrCreateBank) live in accounts/link.ts.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule, but each provider must remember to call it since the provider link functions are still separate copies; a guard placed between helper declarations and the handler type is slightly out of the file's order.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link functions call ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
